title: 28 U.S.C. § 1453 — class-action removal
summary: CAFA creates special federal jurisdiction and removal rules for qualifying class and mass actions. The assigned overview describes an aggregate amount requirement, specified diversity, size conditions, and exceptions.

sections.Role in the course: CAFA creates special federal jurisdiction and removal rules for qualifying class and mass actions. The assigned overview describes an aggregate amount requirement, specified diversity, size conditions, and exceptions.
sections.What to examine: Identify the proposed class, aggregate amount, citizenship relationships, number of members, and any local-controversy, home-state, or other exclusion. Then examine the special removal provisions rather than automatically applying all ordinary diversity-removal limitations.
